0022600134.text: The Charlotte Hornets (2-1, 2nd in the Southeast and 7th in the East) visit the Detroit Pistons (3-0, 1st in the Central and 1st in the East), with the Hornets riding a one-game winning streak and a 1-0 road record. Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee surgery), while Detroit is without Jalen Duren (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Charlotte lost all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 118-100 loss in Charlotte on April 10, 2026.
